$description: The components the ladom-ui CLI can add, by registry name: the source folder in packages/ui/src, the tier and a one-line description. Folders that are not listed (Floating, Brand) are internal parts, added as dependencies; they take the free tier when a free item uses them, else Pro.

button.description: Triggers an action: solid or ghost, seven tones, four sizes.

badge.description: A small label for a status, a category or a count.

chip.description: A compact pill for filters, choices and entered values.

avatar.description: A picture of a person or an account, and AvatarGroup.

loader.description: A spinner, a progress bar or the spinning brand mark.

label.description: The label above a form element.

hint.description: A short helper or status line under form elements.

form-field.description: Label, form element and hint, wired together.

input.description: A one-line text field with icons, affixes, search and password types.

checkbox.description: A checkbox with a label, an indeterminate state and an error.

radio.description: A radio button for picking one of a few options.

choice-group.description: A labelled group of checkboxes or radios.

cell.description: A list row, with CellHelper, CellSearch and CellActions.

dropdown.description: The floating panel that holds Cells.

selectbox.description: Picks one or more values from a list, with search and chips.

segment.description: Picks one of two or three options side by side.

item-selector.description: A field that opens your own picker and shows the picked item.

uploader.description: Collects files by drag and drop, with progress and a file list.

date-picker.description: Picks a day or a range; Calendar and DatePicker.

time-picker.description: Picks a time from hour, minute and second columns.

tabs.description: Switches between views of the same page.

breadcrumb.description: A back button and the path as a menu.

stepper.description: Shows where the user is in a flow of steps.

tooltip.description: A short label on hover and keyboard focus.

popover.description: A small non-modal dialog that opens from a button.

textarea.description: A multi-line text field with an optional character count.

number-input.description: A number field with decrease and increase buttons.

color-input.description: A color field: a swatch that opens a color picker or presets, next to the hex code.

currency-input.description: An amount field masked as it is typed, with a currency picker.

otp-input.description: A one-time code field: a box per character, filled by typing, pasting or SMS autofill, with an optional mask.

gsm-input.description: A phone number field with a country picker; pasted numbers lose their country code and leading 0.

nav-menu.description: SidebarNav and TopNav: simple side and top menus of links for web apps.

empty-state.description: Shows that there is nothing to list, no result or a failed load; large, medium and small.

modal.description: Modal and Drawer: dialogs over the page, on the native <dialog>.

scroll-area.description: A scrolling box with thin, rounded scrollbars that show on hover and while scrolling.

table.description: A data table with sorting and row selection.

pagination.description: Moves between the pages of a list or a table.

alert.description: An inline message about the page.

toast.description: A short message after an action, with ToastProvider and useToast.

accordion.description: A card whose content opens and closes under its title.

app-sidebar.description: A side menu that collapses to a rail of icons, with nested groups.

file-share.description: A "Share this file" panel: link with Copy Link and the people with access.

app-shell.description: The frame of an admin app: side menu, sticky header and page, with the menu in a Drawer on phones.

bar-list.description: Labelled bars for amounts, and Meter, a single bar for a share or progress.

card.description: A dashboard section: a titled surface with actions, content and a footer.

delta.description: A change with a trend arrow: green when it is good news, red when it is bad.

bar-chart.description: Values per category as bars: one series, grouped or stacked, with a grid and a tooltip.

donut-chart.description: Parts of a whole as a ring with a total in the middle; small ones make small multiples.

chart-legend.description: The key of a chart: series dot, name, value columns and a change.

data-toolbar.description: Search, filters and actions above a Table, with bulk actions while rows are selected.

person-cell.description: A person in a table or list: Avatar, name and a line under it.

stat-card.description: A dashboard figure: label, value and a note or trend.

wizard-modal.description: A Modal that walks through steps with a Stepper and Back / Next.
